_readme: Shared settings for every scope. All lengths in mm. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored. Each scope's measurements live in scopes/<name>/scope.json, which can also override any key here. Run: python generate.py [scopes/<name>]

lock._note: A hood drops over the turrets from above; a thin plate slides in under the scope from the left through the lock block into grooves in the hood, and one bolt through the block and plate locks it. Fits with the scope left in its rings.
lock._CLEARANCE: Gap round the turret housing and the turrets
lock._TUBE_CLEARANCE: Gap between the collars and the tube; the hood rests on the tube on its collars
lock._COLLAR_LENGTH: Collar along the tube at each end, from the inside of the hood
lock._PLATE_THICKNESS: Sliding plate under the scope. Thinner = less needed under the scope
lock._PLATE_GAP: Gap between the plate and the lowest part of the scope it slides under. Also how far the hood can lift
lock._PLATE_CLEARANCE: Gap round the plate in its grooves and slot
lock._GROOVE_DEPTH: How far the plate's edges sit into the hood walls
lock._GROOVE_LIP: Wall under the grooves; the hood's lowest point
lock._FINGER_TAB: How far the plate sticks out of the lock block to pull it out by
lock._NUT_TRAP_FLOOR: Material between the plate slot and the nut slot in the lock block
lock.LABEL: ZERO LOCKED
lock._LABEL: Engraved on the left face of the lock block. Empty for none

hardware._note: One M5 x 25 socket head bolt, washer and plain hex nut, upright through the lock block and the plate. Head recessed in the top of the block, nut in a slot opening on its left face.

output._note: Files are written into the profile's folder, named after it: <name>_hood.stl, <name>_plate.stl, <name>_preview.png.
output._CHECK_CLEARANCES: Check the hood going on, the plate sliding in, and the fitted lock against the scope (slower)
